sources.entry: Vid Quiz Creator - macOS application to insert quizzes within video playback and play those videos to receiving devices using the LISNR API.

summary.one_liner: A macOS application for inserting quizzes into video playback and sending those videos to receiving devices via the LISNR API.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and describes Vid Quiz Creator as a macOS application that inserts quizzes within video playback. It says the videos can be played to receiving devices using the LISNR API. The README points to a companion iOS receiver app, sahil-a/vidquizreciever, which it describes as the receiving side. No setup steps, screenshots, or detailed feature list are given, so the specifics of quiz creation and the LISNR integration are not documented here.
use_cases: Adding quizzes to a video during playback
Sending quiz videos to nearby receiving devices
Pairing a macOS creator tool with an iOS receiver app
notable: Delivers video to receiving devices through the LISNR API
Has a companion iOS receiver app in a separate repository
caveats: README is minimal, with no setup or usage instructions
Depends on the LISNR API, a third-party service whose access terms are not described in the README
Requires a companion iOS app to receive videos
